summary: REQ-21 appears implemented via a new client-side ageing-days utility and a new sortable "Ageing Days" column in the invoices table, including safe fallback handling for unparsable dates. REQ-20 appears implemented by showing an admin-only "Clear Old Data" control on the Invoice Management page using the existing useClearAllData mutation and an AlertDialog confirmation, but the diff excerpt of RawDataUploadPage.tsx is truncated before the actual button/dialog wiring is fully visible.
